meta.name: performance
meta.description: Optimize web performance for faster loading and better user experience. Use when asked to "speed up my site", "optimize performance", "reduce load time", "fix slow loading", "improve page speed", or "performance audit".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 优化网站加载速度,提升用户体验
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果网站加载缓慢,想通过优化提升访问速度和用户体验。
copy.tagline_en: Speed up your website and enhance user experience.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your website loads slowly and you want to improve its speed and user experience.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude会检查网页性能,找出加载慢的代码和资源,按对核心体验指标的影响排序,给出带代码示例的优化方案,并用前后指标对比效果。
howto.when: 当你说“speed up my site”“optimize performance”等提速或优化请求,或要求做“performance audit”时触发。

say.text: 我的网站加载很慢,帮我找出原因并优化。
say.note: Claude会定位性能瓶颈并给出优化方案。

say.text: 用性能审计的方式检查这个页面,给出改进建议。
say.note: Claude会按Lighthouse思路生成审计报告。

say.text: 优化一下页面加载时间,重点看图片和脚本。
say.note: Claude会检查图片格式和JS加载策略。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude audits pages like Lighthouse: spots bottlenecks, ranks fixes by Core Web Vitals impact, gives code-level optimizations, and shows before/after metrics.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say 'speed up my site', 'optimize performance', etc., or request a 'performance audit'.

say_en.text: My site loads slowly; help me find the cause and optimize it.
say_en.note: Claude identifies bottlenecks and provides fixes.

say_en.text: Run a performance audit on this page and suggest improvements.
Optimize page load time, focusing on images and scripts.
say_en.note: Claude checks image formats and script loading.
